description: This Java class 'MiniCartController' is a Spring MVC controller that manages shopping cart interactions in a web shop, including displaying the mini cart and removing items from it.

classes.name: MiniCartController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for handling mini shopping cart display and item removal operations within the web shop.

methods.name: displayMiniCart
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to display the mini cart data by shopping cart code, retrieves cart details, updates session attributes, and returns shopping cart data as JSON.

methods.name: removeShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the shopping cart based on line item ID, updates the cart session, deletes the cart if empty, and returns updated cart data.
